solution.approach: Verified Answer: **10** ($9 \times 10 = 90$).
solution.keyConcept: Product of Consecutive n(n+1) = P ⇒ Split Around √P

steps.en: Since $9^2 = 81 < 90 < 10^2 = 100$, the consecutive numbers MUST be **9 & 10**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Quadratic Equation $x(x+1) = 90$: $x(x+1) = 90 \Rightarrow x^2 + x - 90 = 0 \Rightarrow (x + 10)(x - 9) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 9, x+1 = 10$. Answer: **10**.

Method 2: Square Sandwich $9^2 < 90 < 10^2$ (`3 sec`): Since $9^2 = 81 < 90 < 10^2 = 100$, the consecutive numbers MUST be **9 & 10**!
